en.script: We read 1,259 public traces, 153 became leads, 25 passed every gate, and 1 is worth a call now. Today's top 5. Number one: OmicsDiscoveries, Munich. AI-based bioinformatics SaaS for RNA-focused rare disease diagnostics. Worth a call: fit 71, team 69. Number two: Coby, Munich. KI-Plüschbegleiter für Kinder zur Unterstützung bei Gefühlen und Routinen. Fit 81, team still unknown. Still invisible: no press 65 days after our first trace. Number three: Vyoma, Munich. Startup building its own satellites to improve security. Fit 80, team still unknown. We found them 42 days before the press. Number four: SynthesEyes, Munich. Surgery training and simulation system powered by generative AI. Fit 78, team still unknown. We found them 811 days before the press. Number five: NutriSen, Munich. Lab-precise sensors combining remote and on-field data. Fit 78, team still unknown. We found them 576 days before the press. That's the briefing.
